identity.name: DDYs - Compliance as a Service
identity.aesthetic: Bloomberg meets modern SaaS. High density, low noise, functional beauty.

containers.dashboard_panel: h-full flex flex-col bg-white border border-border rounded-md overflow-hidden

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-sm h-9 px-4 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-secondary-foreground border border-input shadow-sm hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-4 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.destructive: bg-destructive text-destructive-foreground hover:bg-destructive/90 shadow-sm h-9 px-4 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

inputs.default: flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

tables.wrapper: relative w-full overflow-auto border rounded-md bg-white
tables.header_cell: h-10 px-4 text-left align-middle font-medium text-muted-foreground [&:has([role=checkbox])]:pr-0

badges.default: inline-flex items-center rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

motion.strategy: Minimal and snappy. No prolonged transitions.

accessibility.contrast: APCA preferred. Text-muted-foreground must be readable.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: All icon-only buttons must have aria-label.

universal_guidelines: Design for data density: Use tight spacing and smaller fonts (text-sm, text-xs) where appropriate to show more data without scrolling.
Use 'IBM Plex Sans' for all headings and 'Inter' for body text. 'JetBrains Mono' for IDs, Keys, and code snippets.
Avoid gradients. Use solid colors and subtle 1px borders for separation.
Never use generic HTML tables; use Shadcn Table component.
All interactive elements must have a data-testid attribute.
Do not use emojis. Use Lucide icons for visual cues.
Light theme only. No dark mode toggle unless requested.
Status indicators (Badges) are critical for risk assessments.

login.layout: Split screen. Left: Branding/Marketing (Clean). Right: Login Form.

tenant_workspace.case_detail: Tabbed Interface. Left Col: Customer Profile (Sticky). Right Col: Tabs (Documents, Screening, Risk, etc.)
